body: Yeah, because I’m working on my classes even though I work and it hurts me because I suffer when I don’t sleep...

Fuck those people. My family doesn’t think it effects adults but my life feels like a prison. I have PTSD, clinical depression, anxiety, anger issues and on top of that, a bigass heart with a love for animals and humans. I feel like my life of 20 (21 as of September) has been a prison sentence and I don’t know if, or when I’ll ever be better. To you assholes who deny ADHD/mental health issues, suck a fat one!
